Glance 2026.08.25 adds fast structured previews for JSON files and improves text copying.

## Highlights

- Preview JSON, JSONL, and NDJSON as progressively parsed structures with depth controls and document statistics.
- Right-click any structured JSON node to copy its complete data as formatted JSON.
- Copy selected text with `Ctrl+C` and automatically clear the selection afterward.
- Keep dynamic component setting text consistent with the main application language.
